name: Shard of Water
summary: Along the Barrens coast, Islen Waterseer receives the Shard of Water from a shaman who has faced corruption.

sections.title: Token of Elemental Purity
sections.body: To master water, a shaman must understand balance, life, and preservation. During the Call of Water, you travel to corrupted springs, crossing the sea to blighted Silverpine Forest. There, you purify the tainted waters and receive the Shard of Water. Then you return the crystal token to Islen Waterseer on the rocky Barrens shore. It proves your worth and provides the final key to forge a Water Totem.

faq.q: What is the Shard of Water used for?
aliases: what does shard of water do
why do i have shard of water
faq.answer: You bring the shard to Islen Waterseer on the Barrens' eastern shore as proof of your trial. Present it to complete your communion with water and earn a Water Totem.

aliases: where to turn in shard of water
faq.answer: Islen Waterseer asks for the shard to confirm you purified tainted water. She is a shaman in a hut south of Ratchet along the Merchant Coast.

faq.q: Why was the trial set as far away as Silverpine?
faq.answer: Water means healing and preservation, while corruption halts life. The tainted waters of Silverpine test whether you can restore elemental harmony amid deep decay.

angles.text: As a shaman, obtaining the shard completes your attunement to water spirits and the long journey to earn your Water Totem.
